text: Riya has 12 apples and buys 8 more. How many apples does she have now?
A shop had 50 chocolates. It sold 18 chocolates. How many chocolates are left?
One notebook costs ₹15. What is the cost of 4 notebooks?
A bus can carry 40 passengers. If 25 passengers are already inside, how many more can enter?
A pack has 6 pencils. How many pencils are there in 5 packs?
Rahul read 18 pages on Monday and 22 pages on Tuesday. How many pages did he read in total?
There are 72 students in 8 rows. How many students are in each row?
A toy costs ₹45. How much will 3 toys cost?
A farmer has 96 mangoes and packs them equally into 12 boxes. How many mangoes are in each box?
Sita had ₹100 and spent ₹37. How much money is left?
A train travels 60 km in one hour. How far will it travel in 4 hours?
There are 5 baskets with 9 oranges each. How many oranges are there in total?
A ribbon is 120 cm long. It is cut into 6 equal pieces. What is the length of each piece?
Priya scored 78 marks in English and 85 marks in Math. What is her total score?
A water bottle costs ₹25. How much do 7 bottles cost?
A baker made 84 cupcakes and placed them equally on 7 trays. How many cupcakes are on each tray?
There are 150 seats in a hall. If 98 seats are occupied, how many seats are empty?
A box contains 24 chocolates. How many chocolates are there in 5 boxes?
A car traveled 320 km in 4 hours. What was its speed per hour?
Anita bought 3 pens for ₹12 each. How much did she spend in total?
